2607.18481.title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
2607.18481.paper_summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires navigating from topic entities to an answer several relations away. Recent methods prompt a frontier LLM to explore the graph through a retrieval tool, but their reliance on frontier-scale inference makes them costly to deploy. We present Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{}), which internalizes this navigation into a compact 8B model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Our central idea is to scaffold a frontier teacher with each question's gold SPARQL query, so the teacher traverses a known answer-bearing path with a live \texttt{Search} tool rather than having to discover the path itself. Since every call executes against a live Freebase server, the resulting trajectories are grounded in the knowledge graph by construction. On WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA, \sogrone{} at 8B surpasses every frozen frontier-LLM system in our comparison and posts the strongest results on CWQ of any system we compare against. It does so using no auxiliary module at inference and no LLM judge during training. Isolating each training stage shows that SFT and RL contribute complementary gains, our approach transfers across model families, and RL learns to reach answers in fewer \texttt{Search} calls than its SFT initialization.
2607.18481.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜問答（KGQA）需要從主題實體導航到幾個關係之外的答案。最近的方法促使前沿 LLM 通過檢索工具探索圖形，但它們對前沿規模推理的依賴使得部署成本高昂。我們提出了 Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{})，它通過監督微調（SFT）隨後的強化學習（RL）將這一導航內化為一個緊湊的 8B 模型。我們的核心思想是用每個問題的金標 SPARQL 查詢來支撐一個前沿教師，這樣教師可以通過一個實時的 \texttt{Search} 工具沿著已知的答案承載路徑進行遍歷，而不必自己發現路徑。由於每次調用都是針對一個實時的 Freebase 伺服器執行，因此生成的軌跡在構建上是基於知識圖譜的。在 WebQSP、CWQ 和 GrailQA 上，\sogrone{} 在 8B 的表現超越了我們比較中的每個冷凍前沿 LLM 系統，並在 CWQ 上取得了我們比較的任何系統中最強的結果。它在推理時不使用任何輔助模塊，並且在訓練期間不使用 LLM 評判。隔離每個訓練階段顯示，SFT 和 RL 互補地貢獻增益，我們的方法在模型家族之間轉移，並且 RL 學會以比其 SFT 初始化更少的 \texttt{Search} 調用來達到答案。
